title: phaseolus vulgaris var. chamaebutyrus
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris var. chamaebutyrus, commonly known as the climbing bean, is a variety of the common bean plant. This plant is used for its edible beans, which are rich in nutrients and provide several health benefits. The health benefits of Phaseolus vulgaris var. chamaebutyrus include reducing the risk of heart disease, managing blood sugar levels, and providing antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and anti-diabetic effects.
